judgments.recommended_next_move: Align public metadata with machine promotion state: remove the held archive workflow from Fair Rent NYC, keep “draft” and collaborator credit everywhere, remove “community-platform work” until WOWList review produces observations, split the 196 scale and template source bases, and add claim-specific tasks for repeated use, publication, and execution evidence.
